title: Beta Tantalum Transmon Qubits with Quality Factors Approaching 10 Million
summary: Tantalum-based transmon qubits are a promising platform for building large-scale quantum processors. So far, these qubits have been made from tantalum films grown exclusively in the alpha phase (α-Ta). The beta phase of tantalum (\{beta}-Ta) readily nucleates at room temperature, making it attractive for scalable qubit fabrication. However, \{beta}-Ta is widely believed to be detrimental to qubit performance because it has a lower superconducting critical temperature than α-Ta. We challenge this prevailing belief by fabricating low-loss transmon qubits from \{beta}-Ta films on sapphire.…
